The '''Karltonian Fiskin''' was a rare, unusual, and valuable [[Coin/Legends|coin]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Karltonia system/Legends|Karltonia system]]. Originating during the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was mostly seen in the [[Collector/Legends|collections]] of [[Historian/Legends|historians]]. One Karltonian Fiskin was a part of the collection of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Randar Dowellin]], which was [[Heist at Randar Dowellin's stronghold|stolen]] by [[Bon Seqours]], a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

Dowellin subsequently employed a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to use a scanner in order to track down the pieces of his [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] collection, many of which he had laced with a [[chemical tracer]]. Seqours attempted to hide at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] [[Cantina/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]], where he gave the Karltonian Fiskin as a tip to the [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]] [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|droid]] [[M-3PO (Treedee)|M-3PO]]. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] then tracked the coin to the establishment, where their attempt to disable the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] led to a shootout involving other patrons of the eatery in which the hunters were defeated.

==Description==
The Karltonian Fiskin was a type of unusual [[Coin/Legends|coin]]<ref name="Journal11" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Karltonia system/Legends|Karltonia system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
===A collection stolen===
[[File:TrandoshanBountyHunter-Journal11.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A group of bounty hunters equipped with a scanner attempted to track down the stolen Karltonian Fiskin.]]
The Karltonian Fiskin originated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Journal11" /> which existed for twenty-five [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] up until [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Journal11" /> between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the coin had become rare and extremely valuable, most commonly being found in the [[Collector/Legends|collections]] of true [[Historian/Legends|historians]]. One Karltonian Fiskin ended up in a collection of unique Republic artifacts kept in the [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Randar Dowellin]]. It was one of the many pieces of the collection that Dowellin laced with a [[chemical tracer]] that could be tracked with the help of a scanner in case of a [[Thief/Legends|theft]].<ref name="Journal11" />

At one point, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bon Seqours]], who was sympathetic to the Alliance and believed that many local crime [[Lord/Legends|lords]] posed a problem to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] inhabitants, particularly those residing in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], carried out a [[Heist at Randar Dowellin's stronghold|heist]] at Dowellin's stronghold in which the latter's collection of artifacts, including the Karltonian Fiskin, was stolen. Carrying it and several other stolen coins on his person, Seqours subsequently attempted to avoid a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] Dowellin had sent out to track down the stolen artifacts.<ref name="Journal11" />

===In the leg of a waiter===
{{RPG|"[[The Farrimmer Cafe]]"}}
{{Quote|It seems that Dowellin's men were a bit closer than I suspected. Luckily the tracer chemical is confused by the bubbling of the Harmon Kizzlebrew.|Bon Seqours|<ref name="Journal11" />}}
[[File:Treedee_SWJ11.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Bon Seqours gave a Karltonian Fiskin to M-3PO (pictured) as a tip.]]
The thief entered the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] [[Cantina/Legends|eatery]]&mdash;with which he was familiar&mdash;aboard the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]]<ref name="Journal11" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]]<ref name="EAOC Mynock">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Mynock 7 Station system/Legends|star system]] containing the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]]</ref> and, spotting a group of individuals [[Diet/Legends|tasting]] a plate of steamed [[yazstrimskizzie]]s, approached them and joined them at their table. Seqours ordered a round of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] [[Harmon Kizzlebrew]], which paired well with the yazstrimskizzies&mdash;but the bubbling of which he also knew would interfere with the ability of the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters']] scanner to detect the tracer chemical.<ref name="Journal11" />

Seqours then threw a few coins, including the Karltonian Fiskin, onto the tray of the [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]] [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|droid]] [[M-3PO (Treedee)|M-3PO]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]], who was secretly stashing tips in order to save up for a full-treatment [[Oil bath/Legends|oil bath]], then hid the coins in a concealed storage compartment in his right [[Limb/Legends|leg]] before walking into the establishment's kitchen. When the other individuals at the table, who noticed the unusual coin, inquired Seqours about it, the thief denied any knowledge of it.<ref name="Journal11" />

Eventually, the bounty hunters followed their scanner's signal into the Farrimmer Cafe, where, due to the interference caused by the Harmon Kizzlebrews, they were forced to start to methodically interrogate the eatery's staff and customers. At one point, M-3PO emerged from the kitchen again, with the scanner detecting the presence of the coin inside his leg. The bounty hunters then attempted to disable the droid, leading to a shootout at the establishment in which the hunters were ultimately defeated.<ref name="Journal11" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarWarsAdventureJournal11.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Karltonian Fisking was introduced in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11.]]
The Karltonian Fiskin appeared in "[[The Farrimmer Cafe]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article authored by [[Jean Rabe]] and [[J. Allan Fawcett]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[November]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. The coin appears in one of the relatively interconnected roleplaying adventure episodes presented in "The Farrimmer Cafe," and the article suggests that the gamemaster player make the player characters noticing and identifying the Karltonian Fiskin one of the game's dice-rolling challenges.<ref name="Journal11" />

Furthermore, "The Farrimmer Cafe" does not establish the coin's fate in wake of the shootout with the bounty hunters, only noting that Bon Seqours thanks the player characters for their assistance and then leaves the Farrimmer Cafe, and that the eatery's droid staff, which includes the surviving M-3PO, dispose of any bodies&mdash;with it also being noted that the establishment's owner, [[H'nib Statermast]], claimed the possessions of anyone [[Death/Legends|perishing]] there. This article assumes that the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Journal11" />
